title: 补数 backfill 规划器：缺失分区与陈旧版本的重跑批次

# 补数 backfill 规划器：日期区间 x 已跑分区 -> 需补跑清单与批次
import datetime

RANGE_START = "2026-03-01"
RANGE_END = "2026-03-15"
TARGET_VERSION = 3          # 口径修复后重跑的版本号
BATCH_SIZE = 4

# 已存在分区及其数据版本
PARTITIONS_A = {
    "2026-03-01": 3, "2026-03-02": 3, "2026-03-03": 3, "2026-03-04": 3,
    "2026-03-05": 3, "2026-03-06": 3, "2026-03-07": 3, "2026-03-08": 3,
    "2026-03-09": 3, "2026-03-10": 3, "2026-03-11": 3, "2026-03-12": 3,
    "2026-03-13": 3, "2026-03-14": 3, "2026-03-15": 3,
}
# 用例 B：03-04 / 03-05 / 03-09 从未跑过；03-06 / 03-07 / 03-12 是旧版本数据
PARTITIONS_B = {
    "2026-03-01": 3, "2026-03-02": 3, "2026-03-03": 3,
    "2026-03-06": 2, "2026-03-07": 2, "2026-03-08": 3,
    "2026-03-10": 3, "2026-03-11": 3, "2026-03-12": 2,
    "2026-03-13": 3, "2026-03-14": 3, "2026-03-15": 3,
}


def date_range(start, end):
    out = []
    cur = datetime.date.fromisoformat(start)
    last = datetime.date.fromisoformat(end)
    while cur <= last:
        out.append(cur.isoformat())
        cur = cur + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    return out


def plan_backfill(existing, start, end, target_version):
    window = date_range(start, end)
    missing, stale = [], []
    for dt in window:
        ver = existing.get(dt)
        if ver is None:
            missing.append(dt)
        elif ver < target_version:
            stale.append(dt)
    todo = sorted(set(missing) | set(stale))
    batches = [todo[i:i + BATCH_SIZE] for i in range(0, len(todo), BATCH_SIZE)]
    return window, sorted(missing), sorted(stale), todo, batches


def report(tag, existing, expect_empty):
    window, missing, stale, todo, batches = plan_backfill(
        existing, RANGE_START, RANGE_END, TARGET_VERSION)
    print("== 用例 " + tag + "：" + ("分区已完整且版本达标（期望 0 个待补）" if expect_empty
                                  else "存在缺失 / 陈旧分区（期望 >0 个待补）") + " ==")
    print("  目标日期区间 = " + RANGE_START + " ~ " + RANGE_END +
          "（共 " + str(len(window)) + " 天）")
    print("  目标数据版本 = " + str(TARGET_VERSION))
    print("  从未产出（缺失分区） = " + str(missing) + "  共 " + str(len(missing)) + " 个")
    print("  版本陈旧需重跑       = " + str(stale) + "  共 " + str(len(stale)) + " 个")
    print("  待补跑分区合计       = " + str(todo) + "  共 " + str(len(todo)) + " 个")
    print("  批次（每批 " + str(BATCH_SIZE) + " 天）:")
    for i, b in enumerate(batches, start=1):
        print("    第 " + str(i) + " 批: " + str(b))
    if not batches:
        print("    （无需补跑）")
    empty = (len(todo) == 0)
    print("  是否符合预期 = " + str(empty == expect_empty))
    return missing, stale, todo, batches


m_a, s_a, t_a, b_a = report("A", PARTITIONS_A, True)
print("")
m_b, s_b, t_b, b_b = report("B", PARTITIONS_B, False)

print("")
print("判据 1（分区齐全且版本达标时无需补数）: " + str(len(t_a) == 0 and len(b_a) == 0))
print("判据 2（缺失分区被识别，且数量 = 3）: " + str(len(m_b) == 3))
print("判据 3（旧版本分区被识别为重跑，且数量 = 3）: " + str(len(s_b) == 3))
print("判据 4（待补总数 = 6，切成 2 批）: " + str(len(t_b) == 6 and len(b_b) == 2))
